turns.q: How many days do I have to return something?
turns.replyTail:
You have:

100 nights from delivery for mattresses, bed bases and beds.
30 nights from receipt for other eligible products, including bed linen and mattress protectors.
14 calendar days from receipt to exercise your legal right of withdrawal.

Refurbished products are excluded from the 100-night trial.

turns.q: How do I start a return or an exchange?
turns.replyTail:
To start a return, use the online return form: https://www.tediber.com/a/return

You’ll need your six-digit order number. If the product has been unpacked, add photos so the return can be approved. For large items, the form will provide a link to schedule a carrier collection. Small parcels receive a printable return label.

We don’t offer direct exchanges. Return the original item for a refund, then place a new order for the product you want.

turns.q: Do I have to pay for return shipping?
turns.replyTail: No, return shipping is free. Small parcels receive a printable return label, and large items are collected by a carrier at the agreed appointment.

turns.q: How long until I get my refund once you receive it?
turns.replyTail: Once our warehouse receives your returned products, your refund is issued to the original payment method within 15 business days.

turns.q: Are any items final sale / non-returnable?
Do I need the original packaging to return something?
turns.replyTail: No, you generally don’t need the original packaging. For bulky items such as mattresses, bed bases and beds, the carrier provides protective covers, so you don’t need to supply your own packaging. For small parcels, attach the return label to the parcel.

turns.q: How do I track the status of my refund?
turns.replyTail:
You can track your refund here: https://www.tediber.com/a/return

Log in with the email address used for your order and your six-digit order number, then open the “Already returned” section to view your return folder and its status.
